compose.stdout:
Bitcoin Bastion Runtime Profile Plan
Profile: compose
Environment: local
Mode: dry-run

Command plan:
- docker compose config
- docker compose --env-file .env up -d --build

Notes:
- Dry-run is the default; apply requires --apply --yes.
- No secrets are generated and no custody/signing behavior is introduced.
- Compose is convenient for local development and small self-hosted tests; it is not HA.

k3s.stdout:
Bitcoin Bastion Runtime Profile Plan
Profile: k3s
Environment: local
Mode: dry-run
Overlay: deploy/kubernetes/overlays/k3s

Command plan:
- kubectl kustomize deploy/kubernetes/overlays/k3s
- kubectl apply -k deploy/kubernetes/overlays/k3s

Notes:
- Dry-run is the default; apply requires --apply --yes.
- No secrets are generated and no custody/signing behavior is introduced.
- K3s often includes Traefik by default.
- Verify local-path storage class if PVCs are used.
- Intended for sovereign VPS/home server/small production with operator evidence.
